title: Morning Always Comes Again
lyrics:
[Verse 1]
The hard time did not last for Job,
though he had waited long;
Heavenly Father blessed him more,
and filled his heart with song.

[Chorus]
And even on the hardest days,
the morning finds its way;
Heavenly Father brings back joy,
He loves you, come what may.

[Verse 2]
Job had a happy home once more,
and family around;
He learned that God is always good,
and joy again was found.

[Chorus]

[Verse 3]
Now close your eyes; the night will pass,
the morning comes again;
Heavenly Father's with you now,
and He'll be with you then.

[Chorus]
mood: Morning music. A warm, lifting sway moves under the voice, like the first light climbing over a hill after a long, dark night. The first two verses rise gently, a little brighter with each line, as joy comes back around to Job. By the last verse the lift eases into a low, slow rock, the promise of morning tucked in beside the child.
